chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Repertoire: pop tunes and Mexican waltzes
summary: The band played pop tunes and Mexican numbers like La Golondrina and Mexicali Rose, with every third number a waltz.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: What kind of numbers would you play with that band? Do you remember?
All the pop tunes of the day. We did a few Mexican numbers, because we had a lot of Mexicans used
to come up there -- "La Golondrina(?)" and "Mexicali Rose" and things like that -- waltzes. Every third number looked like it was a waltz, too, up there.
